name: What factors influence the cost of toilet replacement?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of toilet replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of toilet replacement is primarily influenced by the type of toilet chosen (standard, comfort height, dual flush, wall-mounted), the complexity of the installation, and any necessary plumbing modifications. For instance, upgrading from a standard toilet to a wall-mounted unit might require significant changes to the existing plumbing, increasing labor and material costs. We provide a clear estimate upfront after assessing your current setup and desired new toilet.
acceptedAnswer.description: Toilet replacement costs depend on the toilet type, installation complexity, and required plumbing modifications. Upgrades like wall-mounted units can increase costs.
